$comment: Zero-count regions the browser coverage lane reports that ADR 0007 (adr/0007-scope-end-to-end-coverage-to-user-reachable-states.md) triages out of browser coverage. tests/tools/e2e-coverage-report.mjs counts each entry as neither covered nor uncovered and lists it in its own section; an entry whose span the run no longer reports, or now reports covered, is stale and fails the lane. Only the two ADR 0007 classes qualify: data-shape-guard for an arm selected solely by absent, null, empty or malformed build-time data, and span-drift for a zero that is a source-map artifact of a span another chunk or build records as executed. Spans are quoted from the report's Uncovered regions section.
